calculation_handling.description: Scope statement: the regulations of Section 10.10 apply to all lands, uses, buildings and structures in the R zone. It sets no numeric value; it routes R-zone lots to the Section 10.10 regulations.

10.10.1.10(1).explanation: This states that the rules in Section 10.10 apply to every lot, use, building and structure in the R (Residential) zone. It does not set a limit by itself; it tells us which set of rules governs R-zoned lots.
